## Teaching Materials ### R & RStudio Introductory materials for learning RStudio and performing basic data analysis in R. ::: {.arrow-list} * [Introduction to RStudio & Data Analysis](teaching/intro_r_comunità.html) * [Basic R Commands](teaching/comandi_base_rstudio.html) ::: ### Statistics & Meta-Analysis Lectures, tutorials, and practical exercises on statistical methods, sampling distributions, and meta-analysis. ::: {.arrow-list} * [Meta-Analysis in R – PhD Summer School, University of Cagliari (2026)](https://manentematteo.github.io/meta-analysis-summer-school-cagliari-2026/) * [Sampling Distribution of the Mean](teaching/distribuzione_campionaria_media.html) * [Sampling Distributions of Standard Deviation, Variance, and Mean Differences](teaching/distribuzioni_campionarie_sd_diff.html) ::: ### Academic Writing & Reproducible Research Resources and tutorials for academic writing, thesis preparation, and research workflows. ::: {.arrow-list} * [Academic Writing Resources & Tutorials](materiali_scrittura_tesi.html) :::
## Interactive Shiny Applications ### Linear Models ::: {.arrow-list} * **[Linearity Assumption](https://2j7s28-matteo-manente.shinyapps.io/lm-linearity-assumption/)** Explore the relationship between predictors and outcomes and the assumption of linearity. * **[Homoscedasticity Assumption](https://2j7s28-matteo-manente.shinyapps.io/lm-homoscedasticity-assumption/)** Examine how constant and non-constant error variance affects linear regression. * **[Outliers vs. Leverage](https://2j7s28-matteo-manente.shinyapps.io/lm-outlier-vs-leverage/)** Explore the distinction between outliers and high-leverage observations in linear models. :::
